examples.text: ¿Sabes qué tipo de música le gusta a Roberta?
examples.translation: Do you know what kind of music Roberta likes?
examples.english: Do you know what kind of music Roberta likes?

examples.text: Mi tipo preferido de hombre es el que reconoce cuando es mejor callarse y admitir que yo tengo razón.
examples.translation: My favorite type of man is [the type] who recognizes when it's better to shut up and admit that I'm right.
examples.english: My favorite type of man is [the type] who recognizes when it's better to shut up and admit that I'm right.

examples.text: Tanto Lagarde como Von der Leyen hablaban, sin citarla, de la ventaja comparativa que tendrán de nuevo las empresas alemanas, como en la crisis de 2008 —en realidad nunca la han perdido— al endeudarse a tipos mucho más baratos que las del sur.
examples.ref: 2020 April 25, “Dos mujeres al rescate del sur”, in El País:
examples.english: Both Lagarde and Von der Leyen spoke, without mentioning it, of the comparative advantage that German companies will once again have, as in the 2008 crisis — in reality, they never lost it — by borrowing at much cheaper rates than those in the south.
examples.translation: Both Lagarde and Von der Leyen spoke, without mentioning it, of the comparative advantage that German companies will once again have, as in the 2008 crisis — in reality, they never lost it — by borrowing at much cheaper rates than those in the south.
